question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate synonym of the word in brackets in the following sentence.

In that case, a gentle chemical peel from a dermatologist may __________ up (hasten) improvement.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4 (Speed)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"hasten"** means to cause something to happen sooner or to speed up a process. (शीघ्र करना/तेज़ करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The doctor prescribed medication to **hasten **the recovery process.
 
 
 
• **"Speed"** refers to the rate at which something happens or is done, often implying quickness or acceleration. (गति/तेज़ी)
 
 
• **Example:** The new system helped **speed** up the decision-making process.
 
 
 
• Hence, the synonym of "**hasten**" that fits best in the sentence is **"speed."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4 (Speed)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: Delay** (विलंब) - To postpone or cause something to happen later than expected.

 
 
• **Example:** Heavy rain caused a **delay **in the construction work.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: Stall** (रोकना) - To stop or delay progress deliberately or unintentionally.
 
 
• **Example:** The negotiations **stalled **due to disagreements over the terms.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: Loiter** (आवारा घूमना) - To spend time idly, often without purpose.
 
 
• **Example:** The children were told not to **loiter **around the store after school.
